causal_hypothesis: For the qualified temperature-zero M384 NGRAM verifier, folding BF16 rounding, FP32 softcap, tile-local processors, lowest-ID argmax, and tree acceptance into a vocabulary-tiled output-head consumer removes the global logits interface without changing selected tokens, accepted prefix, completion, or KV ownership.
expected_direction: Lower producer-to-first-KV-commit latency and lower L2/DRAM write traffic on H200; unchanged output-head FLOPs.
stock_control: Pinned SGLang v0.5.13 Gemma4ForCausalLM -> LogitsProcessor materialized FP32 logits -> NgramVerifyInput greedy verify -> fill/free cache.
candidate_change: BM64xBN256 vocabulary tiles emit only per-row post-processor partial argmax state; one request-owned reducer finishes argmax and VerifyTreeGreedy.

inputs.workload: 32 requests x 12 target rows, M384, TP1, temperature zero
inputs.hardware: No hardware used in this experiment; future discriminator is H200 SM90a.

quality_gate: Exact target IDs, tree acceptance, completion, accepted hidden rows, KV slot ownership, committed lengths, and fallback behavior.
slo: CPU oracle must have zero mismatches. Future H200 component must be correctness-passing and positive; no endpoint gain is claimed.
cleanup: No provider or GPU state is created or mutated. CPU compiler output is confined to a project-local TemporaryDirectory and removed on exit.
fidelity: Pinned source trace -> conservation/traffic model -> reduced exact producer CPU oracle -> exact M384x262144 selection geometry CPU oracle. H200 arithmetic, compilation, counters, and latency remain unmeasured.
transfer_limits: CPU results prove semantics and indexing only. They do not prove H200 BF16 GEMM arithmetic, CUDA graph integration, resources, traffic, timing, or endpoint impact.
failure_handling: Source/semantic mismatches are scientific negatives. Compiler, path, parser, or artifact defects are invalid attempts to patch locally. No GPU repair path applies because GPU use is forbidden.
